summary.name: Eclipse Foundation
summary.one_liner: The Eclipse Foundation is a European non-profit that hosts over 450 open source projects under vendor-neutral governance, including the Eclipse IDE.
use_cases: Find open source projects to use or contribute to
Download the Eclipse IDE for Java development
Join or sponsor an open source foundation
Explore industry collaborations on automotive, IoT, and cloud technologies
Attend open source community events and conferences
summary.what_it_does: The page describes the Eclipse Foundation as a community hosting 450+ open source projects with vendor-neutral governance. It promotes exploring projects and industry collaborations in areas such as automotive, IoT, and cloud. It lists downloads, marketplaces, community programs, and learning materials as resources. It also describes three ways to get involved: becoming a member, becoming a sponsor, or contributing as an individual. The page itself does not describe specific software features beyond the directory listings that mention the Eclipse IDE.
notable: Hosts 450+ open source projects under vendor-neutral governance
European foundation with over 20 years of history
Offers membership, sponsorship, and individual contribution paths
caveats: Membership and sponsorship are paid involvement options; pricing details are not on the page
Page is mostly marketing and does not list specific tools or features
